```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Load date definitions
source(here("class_dates.R"))

# Look up a date variable from class_dates.R by name (e.g., "w1d1", "hw0").
# Returns "TBA" for dates not yet set, and the raw text if no variable matches.
get_date_string <- function(var_name) {
  if (is.na(var_name) || var_name == "") return("")
  if (exists(var_name)) return(fmt_date(get(var_name)))
  var_name
}
```

```{r build-table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(kableExtra)

# Load and process schedule data
schedule_raw <- read_csv(here("schedule_data.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", as.character(.))))

# Find row numbers for important events
important_row_indices <- which(
  schedule_raw$type == "due_date" | 
  stringr::str_detect(schedule_raw$date_var, "(?i)hw|exam")
)

schedule_formatted <- schedule_raw %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Fetch formatted date string from class_dates.R
    Date = get_date_string(date_var),
    
    # Format Topic / Due Date highlight styling
    Topic = case_when(
      type == "due_date" ~ sprintf('<span style="color: #3070BF; font-weight: bold;">%s</span>', topic),
      type == "lab" ~ sprintf('<em>%s</em>', topic),
      TRUE ~ topic
    ),
    
    # Generate Iconify HTML
    `Key Info` = if_else(
      !is.na(key_info) & key_info != "", 
      sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="tabler:info-circle-filled" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon></a>', key_info), 
      ""
    ),
    
    Slides = case_when(
      !is.na(slides_qmd) & slides_qmd != "" & !is.na(slides_pdf) & slides_pdf != "" ~ 
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="ri:slideshow-fill" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon></a> &nbsp;&nbsp; <a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="bi:file-earmark-pdf-fill" width="22" height="22"></iconify-icon></a>', slides_qmd, slides_pdf),
      !is.na(slides_qmd) & slides_qmd != "" ~ 
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="ri:slideshow-fill" width="26" height="26"></iconify-icon></a>', slides_qmd),
      !is.na(slides_pdf) & slides_pdf != "" ~ 
        sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="bi:file-earmark-pdf-fill" width="22" height="22"></iconify-icon></a>', slides_pdf),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    
    Recording = if_else(
      !is.na(recording) & recording != "", 
      sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank"><iconify-icon icon="mdi:video" width="28" height="28"></iconify-icon></a>', recording), 
      ""
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Week = lamisc::check_above(week), 
    Date = lamisc::check_above(Date)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Week, 
    Date, 
    Lesson = lesson, 
    Topic, 
    Readings = readings, 
    `Key Info`, 
    Slides, 
    Recording
  )

# Render HTML Table via kable + kableExtra
cat('<div class="table-responsive">')

schedule_formatted %>%
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("c", "c", "c", "l", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
    table.attr = 'class="schedule-table"'
  ) %>%
  row_spec(important_row_indices, extra_css = "font-weight: bold; background-color: #f0f7ff;") %>%
  cat()

cat('</div>')

```
